items.stem: Which sequence matches the handbook's safe-turn guidance?

options.text: Signal three to four seconds ahead, start in the proper lane, control speed and finish in the proper lane

options.text: Signal only after beginning the turn

options.text: Start from any lane if the destination is visible
options.rationale: This alternative changes or omits a condition in the cited guidance: For a safe turn, signal three to four seconds ahead, use the proper starting lane, control speed and finish in the proper lane.

options.text: Accelerate into the turn and choose a lane afterward
